segments.plan: What NivPay does, in the README's words
segments.title: What NivPay does
lines: Passkey accounts: no password and nothing to write down
Send dollars to another person, and receive them
Deliver a payment in another currency through Agora's Instant Settlement
No fee on a send: NivPay covers it
People see dollars and names, never keys or addresses

segments.title: Pots: a group purse for one purpose
lines: It can only come out to destinations fixed when the pot was created
And only when enough of the named approvers agree
Any funder can exit at any time with their share of what is unspent
